label: copy-phase input of fed-back letter "a"
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost exclusively (97% of mass) on steps where the fed-back input is the letter a (a copied a being re-read), at recall_idx >= 2. It never fires in the original phase or at the delimiter, and almost never on other inputs (small residue on p, k, j). Selective though: only ~20% of copy-phase a inputs activate. Magnitude is highest in short sequences (L=4-5) near the end of the copy (to_go 0-1, recall_idx 3), and highest of all when the a is followed by p (pattern x y a p <DEL> x y a). Adding L<=5 raises precision to 0.56 but recall drops to 0.43. Out_tok p/k/j/t raise the firing rate but do not fully determine it.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: a, p, k, j, t, -; least: 3, e, n, f) and the token being output (most: p, a, k, j, r, t; least: z, -, h, x); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=4 & t=6.
